basic_info.description: Located in one of the best parts of the Marina, San Francisco's coolest waterfront neighborhood this turn-key, updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo offers 1,124 sq. ft. of living space (per tax records). Built in 1925, the home blends classic charm with modern updates, creating a stylish residence surrounded by waterfront beauty, walkability, and city energy.  The boutique 2-unit building includes earthquake insurance, one-car side-by-side garage parking, extra storage, and in-unit laundry, plus a shared yard for outdoor enjoyment. Inside, an inviting eat-in kitchen pairs functionality with period warmth.  With a Walk Score of 93, Chestnut and Union Streets are steps away with top restaurants, cafes, fitness studios, and conveniences. Marina Green is a five-minute walk, Fort Mason is minutes away, and countless trails, parks, and sweeping bay views are part of daily life. Offering charm, convenience, and turnkey updates, this condo delivers both a beautiful home and an extraordinary lifestyle in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods.
